rules.accepted_credit_types: Hours awarded by an ACCME-accredited sponsor and designated AMA PRA Category 1, or AAFP prescribed credit, or AOA prescribed credit; up to 10 hours for disciplinary case review done for the Department
rules.new_licensee_rule: Exempt only for the calendar year of licensure if licensed in the same calendar year as passing USMLE Step 3.
rules.audit_note: Keep certificates/letters/AAFP records for 4 years from the end of the calendar year the CME was earned; produce them if the Division requests in writing. Deficiency: $100 civil penalty per missing hour, make-up hours plus 10 penalty hours.
rules.alternatives: ACGME residents/fellows in good standing may claim up to 20 hours per training year (letter from program director); the 2-hour prescribing course is still required. Waiver possible for illness, disability or undue hardship if requested before the period ends.

topics.who: All licensees (part of the 40 hours); must be Tennessee-specific and cover the Department's guidelines on opioids, benzodiazepines, barbiturates and carisoprodol. Exempt: ABMS/AOA/ABPS-certified in pain management, anesthesiology, PM&R, neurology or rheumatology

rules.notes: License expires the last day of the birth month under the biennial birthdate renewal system; CME must fall in the 24 months before that date. Renewal fee $300 plus $10 state regulatory fee every 2 years. Retired/inactive licenses are exempt.
rules.legal_basis: Tenn. Comp. R. & Regs. 0880-02-.19 (Continuing Medical Education); 0880-02-.09; T.C.A. § 63-1-402

rules.accepted_credit_types: AOA Category I-A, II-A and/or I-B (no more than 20 credits in I-B); courses approved by the AOA, ACCME or an ACCME-recognized state medical association, or AAFP prescribed credit
rules.new_licensee_rule: Exempt only for the calendar year of licensure if licensed in the same calendar year as passing NBOME/COMLEX or USMLE Step 3.
rules.audit_note: Keep certificates, letters, AAFP records or transcripts for 4 years from the end of the calendar year the CME was earned; produce them if the Division requests in writing.
rules.alternatives: Waiver possible for illness, disability or undue hardship if requested before the renewal period ends.

topics.who: All licensees unless exempt under T.C.A. 63-1-402(c) (part of the 40 hours); must cover the Department's guidelines on opioids, benzodiazepines, barbiturates and carisoprodol

rules.notes: DOs are licensed by the separate Tennessee Board of Osteopathic Examination (tn.gov/health/licensure/ost.html). License expires the last day of the birth month (biennial birthdate system). Renewal fee $200 plus $10 state regulatory fee biennially.
rules.legal_basis: Tenn. Comp. R. & Regs. 1050-02-.12 (Continuing Education Requirements)
